== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata)]]: the region (420, 708, 628, 756) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif Holotable commit 73ae2bd] (2023-12-20). The matching after crop is [[:File:V23-D-zuckusswithsnarerifle-2024-08-02-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif commit 73ae2bd]) and [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif commit 0151016]).
